decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (1101/P/01, 1101/P/02, 1101/P/03 A, and 1101/P/04 A; all received 6 June 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The flank window to the second floor bathroom to No. 52 hereby approved shall have fixed, obscured glazing and shall not be replaced other than with fixed obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension to No.52 and erection of second floor rear mansard roof extensions to both houses.
